title.zh: 光刻：把图形投到晶圆上
title.en: Lithography: projecting patterns onto a wafer

subtitle.zh: 核心看 CD、overlay 与工艺窗口
subtitle.en: Focus on CD, overlay, and process window

body.zh: 涂胶 → 曝光 → 显影 → 图形化胶层。图中堆栈为光刻胶/SiO₂/Si 晶圆，UV 光通过掩模板（Mask）照射光刻胶。
body.en: Coat resist → expose → develop → patterned resist. The illustrated stack is resist/SiO₂/Si wafer; UV light passes through a mask onto the resist.

body.zh: CD 控制：检查线宽（CD）过大或过小。Overlay 对准：比较参考层与目标图形，检查图形偏移。焦深窗口：关注偏离焦点（Z）时的工艺窗口（焦深）。
body.en: CD control: check whether linewidth is too large or too small. Overlay alignment: compare reference layer and target pattern for displacement. Depth-of-focus window: monitor the process window as focus offset Z changes.

body.zh: CD-SEM 量测图像与线形信号用于确定 CD；overlay 量测给出 ΔX、ΔY 偏移量。量测反馈用于优化工艺。
body.en: CD-SEM images and signal profiles determine CD; overlay metrology reports offsets ΔX and ΔY. Feed these measurements back to optimize the process.

uncertain: 底部反馈箭头或文字接近水印，裁切优先保留完整实质内容。
